title: The Last Sword You Never Forgot - Community Port (1.21.1+)
summary: Unofficial NeoForge port of The Last Sword You Never Forgot by CJiangqiu to newer Minecraft, maintained by the community with the author's permission.
differences: The Ultra Test Sword's lockdown mode and the Test Entity don't turn on Epic Core API's global "AllReturn" in this version. That's an experimental feature that didn't play well with some other mods on 1.21.1.
original_name: The Last Sword You Never Forgot

sources.label: The Last Sword You Never Forgot by CJiangqiu
sources.note: An unofficial port of the original to NeoForge 1.21.1, with the original's content.

disclosures.note: The changes that port the original to NeoForge 1.21.1, and this page's text, were made with an AI coding assistant and checked by automated gates and a person playing it. The mod's content, art and design are the original author's.
